data.name: Mirtunjay
data.gender_notes: Mirtunjay is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mirtunjay is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Mrit' (death) and 'Anjay' (victory). This name is believed to symbolize the victory of life over death. The name Mirtunjay carries the meaning “Victory over death” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mirtunjay usually hope their child will grow to embody victory over death and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embrace the cycle of life and death with courage and wisdom.
data.etymology: Mirtunjay belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victory over death.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mirtunjay total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Mirtunjay is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology, with the most famous character holding this name being King Mirtunjay of the epic Mahabharata. He was an ideal king, known for his bravery, righteousness, intelligence, and leadership qualities. His name became synonymous with invincibility, indicating the ultimate triumph of good over evil.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Mirtunjay holds a deeper meaning, representing the spiritual journey of an individual towards victory over eternal cycle of birth, death, and rebirth (samsara). The name resonates with the belief that, with the right wisdom and determination, one can achieve liberation from this cycle.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Mirtunjay: Victory over death; a name that bestows immortality and invincibility. The one who carries the divine poison Amrita, symbolizing the conqueror of time and death.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Mirtunjay is a name of Lord Vishnu in Hindu mythology. The name Mirtunjay carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Mirtunjay is a divine name, a form of Lord Vishnu, and is mentioned in various Hindu scriptures.

trends: Mirtunjay is a popular name for boys in India.
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Mirtunjay remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.

name_in_real_life.story: Amit Mirtunjay, a teacher in Chennai, India, shares that their name Mirtunjay meaning "Victory over death" has been a constant source of inspiration, motivating them to follow Hindu values and serve their community.
